subject: Short exec demo — compact evening slot options for US customer / EU team
messages:
From: Sara King <sara.king@brightfit.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightFit Demo <demo@brightfit.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 08:15:00 -0400
Subject: Request: short executive demo — preferred late afternoon ET

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for connecting last week. Our VP of Product is only available at the end of the day next week and asked if we can do a short (~30–45 min) demo that ends by 18:00 ET on Tue/Wed (Mar 23/24). That would be 23:00–23:45 CET for your EU engineers, which I realize is late.

If that exact window is impossible, could you propose a compact option that minimizes after-hours for your team? Our goals are: a 30–45 minute executive overview, a quick live prompt + Q&A, and a short follow-up doc. We can accept either a slightly earlier slot (16:30–17:15 ET) or a later one (18:00 ET) if needed — flexible on length.

Thanks — we want to make this painless for your on-call folks.

Best,
Sara
Sara King
Head of Partnerships, BrightFit
[sara.king@brightfit.com]

Attachments: none
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and for flagging the constraints.

We want to avoid asking the EU engineering team to stay extremely late, so I pulled a compact-slot matrix (attached) with three options that balance your exec availability and our covering engineers:

1) Tue, Mar 23 — 16:30–17:15 ET (21:30–22:15 CET): on-call engineer + product lead (we keep to 35 min, focused demo + Q&A)
2) Tue, Mar 23 — 17:30–18:15 ET (22:30–23:15 CET): exec-friendly for you, heavier after-hours for engineering — we can rotate on-call presenter to limit exposure
3) Wed, Mar 24 — 13:00–13:45 ET (18:00–18:45 CET): mid-afternoon for EU, midday for US — longer travel for your execs but fully within business hours for us

If none of these work we can record a short run-through with an on-call available for live Q&A at a follow-up hour.

I've attached a compact_slot_matrix.csv that shows who would be on-call and the expected prep required for each option. Please let us know which of the three you'd prefer and whether you need a 30 or 45 minute slot.

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Mateo.Alvarez@redwood.com

Mateo — quick note from the EU engineering side. Option 1 (21:30–22:15 CET) is doable but we should cap participation to two engineers and avoid deep debugging. Option 2 pushes into 23:15 CET which is a hard limit for most folks — I can make it but prefer not to rotate the whole team. Option 3 is ideal for engineering, minimal disruption.

If we pick Option 1, please confirm we keep the agenda tight (demo → 10 min prompts → 15 min live Q&A) and that we share a recording immediately. If BrightFit needs any specific test data or prompts, send those by EOD Monday so we can prep.

—Sooj

Thanks both — this is helpful. I spoke with the VP and we can be flexible. We have two preferences in descending order:

• Preference A: Tue, Mar 23 — 16:30–17:15 ET (Option 1) — we’ll trim the agenda to 35 minutes; VP can stay until 17:15 ET.
• Preference B: Wed, Mar 24 — 13:00–13:45 ET (Option 3) — if Option 1 is a no-go, this is our fallback.

We prefer Option 1 to keep it closer to their day. We will provide one sample prompt and a short data template by EOD Monday (Mar 22). If you can confirm two engineers + product lead for Option 1 and that you’ll record and share the recording within 2 hours, we’ll lock it in and send calendar invites.

Thanks — Sara

Sara — great, Option 1 is confirmed on our side. Confirming the plan:

• Tue, Mar 23, 2026 — 16:30–17:15 ET (21:30–22:15 CET) — 35-minute compact exec demo
• Attendees (Redwood): Mateo (product + slides), Soojin (live prompts, engineering), backup on-call (Lauren) on standby
• Deliverables: recording posted to the shared drive and a 1-page follow-up with prompt examples within 2 hours after the call
• Prep: BrightFit to send sample prompt + data template by EOD Mon, Mar 22.

I'll send a calendar invite (separate email) and add a short runbook for the engineers to keep the session tight. Thanks for being flexible — we appreciate the heads-up and will keep this compact to respect after-hours boundaries.

Mateo
